scope: Local vendor-package string extraction, public non-GitHub web searches, DNS and archive index queries. No device requests, firmware changes, credentials obtained, contacts, posts, or GitHub access.

new_lead.limits: Strings establish endpoint and authentication-related code references, not fully traced request semantics. Existing ELF helper cannot disassemble this binary because it lacks the expected section symbol tables. Binary was not executed.

results.dns: Google public resolver returned status 3 (NXDOMAIN) for api.xwemo.com and fw.xbcs.net at query time. This does not prove their historical infrastructure or every alternate host is unavailable.
results.wayback: Both xwemo queries and both vendor-storage 11565 queries returned empty arrays. Absence is scoped to these indexes and URL patterns.
results.commoncrawl: Six targeted queries over December 2025, December 2024, and November/December 2023 snapshots. Four no-capture responses; two gateway errors retried separately. Not an exhaustive Common Crawl scan.
results.vendor_catalog: Belkin Open Source Code Center still lists F7C063 2.00.11420. No 11565 link located.
results.bootloader_search: Searches for F7C063/MT7688/SNSV2 bootloader produced no matching downloadable bootloader. RT5350/F7C027 and Insight serial-recovery guides are other hardware, not proof for this Mini.

limits: Negative searches do not prove no copy exists. A vendor update image may omit bootloader and device-specific partitions; obtaining it would not by itself establish recovery.
